task: Describe a family member's weekly routine.
student_text: My cousin walks to the bakery every Saturday morning. She buys a loaf of bread and a small cake for our family. The shop open at seven, so she can visit before her piano lesson begins.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My cousin walks to the bakery every Saturday morning. She buys a loaf of bread and a small cake for our family. The shop opens at seven, so she can visit before her piano lesson begins.

errors.explanation: Use the third-person singular form opens with the singular subject shop.

task: Write about a concert you attended last week.
student_text: Last Friday, I go to a small concert with my older brother. The band played several songs that we both knew. We stood near the back, and we took the bus home after the show.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Last Friday, I went to a small concert with my older brother. The band played several songs that we both knew. We stood near the back, and we took the bus home after the show.

errors.explanation: Use went, the past form of go, for the finished event last Friday.

task: Tell a friend what you ate at a picnic.
student_text: On Sunday, our family had lunch in the park beside the river. I packed a orange for my little sister, and Dad brought sandwiches. We stayed until the clouds came, then walked back to the car.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: On Sunday, our family had lunch in the park beside the river. I packed an orange for my little sister, and Dad brought sandwiches. We stayed until the clouds came, then walked back to the car.

errors.explanation: Use an before orange, which begins with a vowel sound.

task: Describe a place you visited on a school trip.
student_text: Our class visited a farm outside town in May. We saw two horses, three sheep, and several goat near the gate. The farmer showed us how he fed the animals before we ate lunch in the barn.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Our class visited a farm outside town in May. We saw two horses, three sheep, and several goats near the gate. The farmer showed us how he fed the animals before we ate lunch in the barn.

errors.explanation: Use the plural noun goats after the quantity word several.

task: Write about preparing a room for visitors.
student_text: The cupboard held six clean towels after laundry, so I placed some of clean towels on the shelf for our guests. My parents were expecting my aunt and uncle, and I added a bar of soap beside each towel. We finished the room before lunch.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: The cupboard held six clean towels after laundry, so I placed some of the clean towels on the shelf for our guests. My parents were expecting my aunt and uncle, and I added a bar of soap beside each towel. We finished the room before lunch.
acceptable_alternatives: The cupboard held six clean towels after laundry, so I placed some clean towels on the shelf for our guests. My parents were expecting my aunt and uncle, and I added a bar of soap beside each towel. We finished the room before lunch.

errors.explanation: After some of, use a determiner such as the before a plural noun; alternatively, remove of.

task: Tell someone how you felt after a long walk.
student_text: Yesterday, we walked through the town center for nearly two hours. We stopped to look at the market stalls and bought a small map. I was tired becaus I had carried a heavy bag all the way from home.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Yesterday, we walked through the town center for nearly two hours. We stopped to look at the market stalls and bought a small map. I was tired because I had carried a heavy bag all the way from home.

errors.explanation: Spell because with the letters e-a-u in the middle.

task: Write about a class that begins next week.
student_text: Our art course begins next monday at the town library. The teacher asked everyone to bring a pencil and a notebook. I am excited because my friend Leo is taking the same course with me.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Our art course begins next Monday at the town library. The teacher asked everyone to bring a pencil and a notebook. I am excited because my friend Leo is taking the same course with me.

errors.explanation: Capitalize the name of the day Monday.

task: Describe where you keep your clothes.
student_text: I keep my coats and scarves on the bedroom, beside the door. A small basket holds my gloves, and my shoes stay under the bed. This makes it easy to get ready when I leave home early.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I keep my coats and scarves in the bedroom, beside the door. A small basket holds my gloves, and my shoes stay under the bed. This makes it easy to get ready when I leave home early.

errors.explanation: Use in for something located inside a room.

task: Describe a regular family visit.
student_text: We visit my aunt at Sunday afternoons, usually after lunch. She lives above a small bakery, so we can walk there in ten minutes. She has a collection of postcards from different towns, and she shows us one each time we visit.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: We visit my aunt on Sunday afternoons, usually after lunch. She lives above a small bakery, so we can walk there in ten minutes. She has a collection of postcards from different towns, and she shows us one each time we visit.

errors.explanation: Use on with a day of the week.

task: Ask a neighbor to lend you a tool.
student_text: I am fixing a loose shelf in my kitchen this afternoon. My neighbor has a small hammer, so I asked if I can to borrow it for an hour. I will return it before she goes to work.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I am fixing a loose shelf in my kitchen this afternoon. My neighbor has a small hammer, so I asked if I can borrow it for an hour. I will return it before she goes to work.

errors.explanation: A modal such as can is followed directly by the base verb borrow.

task: Write about a family member's food preferences.
student_text: My brother doesn't likes spicy food, so he orders soup when we eat at the new restaurant. I usually choose rice with vegetables. We both enjoy the quiet music there, and the waiter remembers our names.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My brother doesn't like spicy food, so he orders soup when we eat at the new restaurant. I usually choose rice with vegetables. We both enjoy the quiet music there, and the waiter remembers our names.

errors.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form like.

task: Tell a friend about a phone call you will make.
student_text: My bus leaves in ten minutes, but I need to speak with the dentist first. I will calling the clinic from the station and ask for a new appointment. Then I can catch the next bus.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My bus leaves in ten minutes, but I need to speak with the dentist first. I will call the clinic from the station and ask for a new appointment. Then I can catch the next bus.

errors.explanation: Use the base form call after will.

task: Describe how you cleaned your room yesterday.
student_text: Yesterday afternoon, I clean my room before my cousins came over. I put my books on the shelf and carried the dirty clothes to the laundry basket. After that, I opened the window to let in some fresh air.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Yesterday afternoon, I cleaned my room before my cousins came over. I put my books on the shelf and carried the dirty clothes to the laundry basket. After that, I opened the window to let in some fresh air.

errors.explanation: Use cleaned for an action completed yesterday.

task: Compare two winter coats you own.
student_text: The red coat is more warmer than the blue one, but it has a lighter lining. I wear it on cold mornings and keep the other coat in my bag when the weather may change. Both are useful in winter.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: The red coat is warmer than the blue one, but it has a lighter lining. I wear it on cold mornings and keep the other coat in my bag when the weather may change. Both are useful in winter.
acceptable_alternatives: The red coat is more warm than the blue one, but it has a lighter lining. I wear it on cold mornings and keep the other coat in my bag when the weather may change. Both are useful in winter.

errors.explanation: Use warmer without more; do not combine more with the -er comparative.

task: Describe the highest building you can see.
student_text: From the top of our apartment, I can see the most tallest building in the neighborhood. It has many windows and a blue roof. At night, the lights make it easy to find from our street.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: From the top of our apartment, I can see the tallest building in the neighborhood. It has many windows and a blue roof. At night, the lights make it easy to find from our street.

errors.explanation: Use one superlative form: the tallest.

task: Describe what a family is doing before lunch.
student_text: Look at the people in the kitchen. Two children are make sandwiches for lunch, and their father is putting cups on the table. Their mother is washing some fruit in the sink while the radio plays softly.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Look at the people in the kitchen. Two children are making sandwiches for lunch, and their father is putting cups on the table. Their mother is washing some fruit in the sink while the radio plays softly.

errors.explanation: Use the -ing form making after are to form the present continuous.

task: Write about a place you have visited several times.
student_text: My parents have visited the castle near our town many times, but my little brother has went only once. He wants to climb the steps to the top again because he liked looking at the fields through its windows.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My parents have visited the castle near our town many times, but my little brother has gone only once. He wants to climb the steps to the top again because he liked looking at the fields through its windows.

errors.explanation: The present perfect uses the past participle gone after has.

task: Tell a friend about a hobby you enjoy.
student_text: I enjoy to draw small pictures when I have free time. I usually sit by the kitchen window and sketch flowers or cups. My cousin likes painting, so sometimes we work at the table together.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I enjoy drawing small pictures when I have free time. I usually sit by the kitchen window and sketch flowers or cups. My cousin likes painting, so sometimes we work at the table together.

errors.explanation: Enjoy is followed by an -ing form, so use enjoy drawing.

task: Describe something you borrowed from a family member.
student_text: I borrowed my brothers phone yesterday because mine had no battery. He let me call home, and I gave it back before dinner. I charged my own phone overnight and thanked him this morning.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I borrowed my brother's phone yesterday because mine had no battery. He let me call home, and I gave it back before dinner. I charged my own phone overnight and thanked him this morning.

errors.explanation: Add apostrophe-s to show that the phone belongs to one brother.

task: Write about a problem you solved with a friend.
student_text: My friend couldnt find the address of the new sports center, so I sent her a map on my phone. We met outside the library and walked there together. The trip took about fifteen minutes.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My friend couldn't find the address of the new sports center, so I sent her a map on my phone. We met outside the library and walked there together. The trip took about fifteen minutes.

errors.explanation: Write the contraction couldn't with an apostrophe.

task: Ask about the start time of a film.
student_text: I want to see the new comedy at the cinema tonight. What time the film starts? My sister has the tickets, and she said we should meet outside the entrance before the doors open.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I want to see the new comedy at the cinema tonight. What time does the film start? My sister has the tickets, and she said we should meet outside the entrance before the doors open.

errors.correction: What time does the film start?
errors.explanation: A present simple question needs does before the subject and the base verb start.
acceptable_corrections: What time does the film start?

task: Tell a friend who you invited to a meal.
student_text: I am having lunch with my cousins tomorrow. I invited she to join us because she lives nearby and knows the restaurant well. We plan to meet at one o'clock and order something different to share.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I am having lunch with my cousins tomorrow. I invited her to join us because she lives nearby and knows the restaurant well. We plan to meet at one o'clock and order something different to share.

errors.explanation: Use the object pronoun her after the verb invited.

task: Introduce a person in a family photo.
student_text: This is a photo from my uncle's birthday last summer. Him is the man beside the window, and the two children are my cousins. Everyone ate cake in the garden before the rain started.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: This is a photo from my uncle's birthday last summer. He is the man beside the window, and the two children are my cousins. Everyone ate cake in the garden before the rain started.

errors.explanation: Use the subject pronoun he as the subject of is.

task: Describe the places you like to visit nearby.
student_text: My favorite places is the small bookshop and the cafe next door. I go there after school when I have money for a snack. The owner knows my name and often tells me about new books.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My favorite places are the small bookshop and the cafe next door. I go there after school when I have money for a snack. The owner knows my name and often tells me about new books.

errors.explanation: Use are with the plural subject places.

task: Write about buying things for a new room.
student_text: We moved into a larger flat last month and needed some furniture. The shop sells several useful furnitures, including tables, chairs, and lamps. We chose a small desk for my room and a sofa for the living room.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: We moved into a larger flat last month and needed some furniture. The shop sells several useful pieces of furniture, including tables, chairs, and lamps. We chose a small desk for my room and a sofa for the living room.
acceptable_alternatives: We moved into a larger flat last month and needed some furniture. The shop sells several useful items of furniture, including tables, chairs, and lamps. We chose a small desk for my room and a sofa for the living room.

errors.explanation: Furniture is uncountable in English; use pieces of furniture when counting individual items.

task: Describe your mother's routine at home.
student_text: My mother cook dinner at about six every evening. She usually makes rice or soup, and my father sets the table while she works. After dinner, we wash the dishes together and choose a film to watch.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My mother cooks dinner at about six every evening. She usually makes rice or soup, and my father sets the table while she works. After dinner, we wash the dishes together and choose a film to watch.

errors.explanation: Use cooks in the present simple for the routine of one person.

task: Tell a friend about an outdoor game.
student_text: We met at the park after school and played football until the sun went down. My team scored twice, and the other team scored once. Everyone was tired, but nobody wanted to go home after the game
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: We met at the park after school and played football until the sun went down. My team scored twice, and the other team scored once. Everyone was tired, but nobody wanted to go home after the game.

errors.explanation: End a complete written sentence with a full stop.

task: Explain why you walked home after school.
student_text: Because the bus was full, so my sister and I walked home from school. It was not far, and the weather was sunny. We stopped at a shop to buy cold drinks before we reached our street.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Because the bus was full, my sister and I walked home from school. It was not far, and the weather was sunny. We stopped at a shop to buy cold drinks before we reached our street.
acceptable_alternatives: The bus was full, so my sister and I walked home from school. It was not far, and the weather was sunny. We stopped at a shop to buy cold drinks before we reached our street.

errors.original: Because the bus was full, so
errors.explanation: Use because without the extra so in the same clause.

task: Describe a place you want to study.
student_text: I hope to study at an university near the coast one day. My cousin goes there now and says the library is quiet. She often studies with friends after class and takes a bus home in the evening.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I hope to study at a university near the coast one day. My cousin goes there now and says the library is quiet. She often studies with friends after class and takes a bus home in the evening.

errors.explanation: University begins with a consonant /y/ sound, so use a.

task: Write about tickets for a trip.
student_text: We are planning a short trip to the city museum next month. I bought one tickets for the bus, and my friend will buy the other one tomorrow. We want to arrive early so we can see every room.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: We are planning a short trip to the city museum next month. I bought one ticket for the bus, and my friend will buy the other one tomorrow. We want to arrive early so we can see every room.

errors.explanation: Use a singular noun after one.

task: Tell someone when your appointment begins.
student_text: My dentist is seeing me tomorrow in eight o'clock. I need to arrive early because I have a form to complete at the front desk. My mother will wait outside and take me to school afterward.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My dentist is seeing me tomorrow at eight o'clock. I need to arrive early because I have a form to complete at the front desk. My mother will wait outside and take me to school afterward.

errors.explanation: Use at before a specific clock time.

task: Write about a rule for using a classroom computer.
student_text: Our teacher said we could use the new computer for our projects. We must to save our work before we close the program, and we should keep drinks away from the desk. Everyone follows these rules carefully.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Our teacher said we could use the new computer for our projects. We must save our work before we close the program, and we should keep drinks away from the desk. Everyone follows these rules carefully.

errors.explanation: Use the base verb save directly after must.

task: Describe a dessert you tried at a cafe.
student_text: My friend and I ordered a lemon cake after lunch. The cake very sweet, but we both finished our pieces. We walked to the bus stop and talked about music while the rain stopped.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My friend and I ordered a lemon cake after lunch. The cake was very sweet, but we both finished our pieces. We walked to the bus stop and talked about music while the rain stopped.

errors.explanation: Add was to make a complete past-tense description with the singular subject cake.

task: Tell a friend about a race at school.
student_text: Last week, my classmates and I entered a short race around the school field. I runned slowly because I had new shoes, but I finished with my friend. Our teacher gave everyone a bottle of water afterward.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Last week, my classmates and I entered a short race around the school field. I ran slowly because I had new shoes, but I finished with my friend. Our teacher gave everyone a bottle of water afterward.

errors.explanation: The past form of run is ran.

task: Explain why you arrived late to a lesson.
student_text: I was late for my guitar lesson becuase the bus stopped for a long time near the station. My teacher waited for me, and we used the remaining time to practice two songs for the school concert.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I was late for my guitar lesson because the bus stopped for a long time near the station. My teacher waited for me, and we used the remaining time to practice two songs for the school concert.

errors.explanation: Spell because with e before a-u.

task: Write about a family holiday destination.
student_text: Last summer, we spent five days in italy with my aunt and uncle. We visited a beach, ate dinner outside, and took many pictures. My cousins want to return next year because they loved swimming in the sea.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Last summer, we spent five days in Italy with my aunt and uncle. We visited a beach, ate dinner outside, and took many pictures. My cousins want to return next year because they loved swimming in the sea.

errors.explanation: Capitalize the name of a country.

task: Describe the weather you see outside now.
student_text: Look through the window at the garden. It is rain hard, and people are hurrying past the gate with umbrellas. My father is making tea while we wait for the weather to change before our walk.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Look through the window at the garden. It is raining hard, and people are hurrying past the gate with umbrellas. My father is making tea while we wait for the weather to change before our walk.

errors.explanation: Use the -ing form raining after is for an action happening now.

task: Write about a room shared by two sisters.
student_text: My cousins share one bedroom at their house. The girls room has two beds, a large wardrobe, and a desk by the window. They keep their books in separate boxes so each person can find things easily.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My cousins share one bedroom at their house. The girls' room has two beds, a large wardrobe, and a desk by the window. They keep their books in separate boxes so each person can find things easily.

errors.explanation: Add an apostrophe after the plural noun girls to show shared ownership.

task: Ask a friend about a meal they ate yesterday.
student_text: We had dinner at a new cafe near the station last night. Did you saw the menu before you ordered? The waiter told us about a soup special, and my sister tried it with fresh bread.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: We had dinner at a new cafe near the station last night. Did you see the menu before you ordered? The waiter told us about a soup special, and my sister tried it with fresh bread.

errors.explanation: After did, use the base form see in a past-tense question.

task: Tell a friend how a neighbor helped you.
student_text: Last night, the heating stopped working and the room became cold. I asked my neighbor if she could lends me a blanket, and she brought one from upstairs. I thanked her and returned it this morning before she left for work.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Last night, the heating stopped working and the room became cold. I asked my neighbor if she could lend me a blanket, and she brought one from upstairs. I thanked her and returned it this morning before she left for work.

errors.explanation: Use the base form lend after the modal verb could.

task: Explain why you plan to try a station cafe with your sister.
student_text: I have never ate breakfast at the station cafe, but my sister goes there every Monday. She says the toast is good and the staff are kind. Next week, I will join her before we catch the early train.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I have never eaten breakfast at the station cafe, but my sister goes there every Monday. She says the toast is good and the staff are kind. Next week, I will join her before we catch the early train.

errors.explanation: The present perfect uses the past participle eaten after have.

task: Describe what a friend does after class.
student_text: My best friend speak with the school librarian every afternoon. He returns his books, asks for something new to read, and then waits for me by the front door. We usually walk to the bus stop together.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My best friend speaks with the school librarian every afternoon. He returns his books, asks for something new to read, and then waits for me by the front door. We usually walk to the bus stop together.

errors.explanation: Use speaks with the singular subject friend.

task: Write about a trip to a lake with your family.
student_text: Last Tuesday, we visit a lake outside town with our cousins. We packed a old blanket and some fruit, then sat near the water. The children played with a ball while the adults made lunch.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Last Tuesday, we visited a lake outside town with our cousins. We packed an old blanket and some fruit, then sat near the water. The children played with a ball while the adults made lunch.

errors.explanation: Use visited for the finished trip last Tuesday.
Use an before old, which begins with a vowel sound.

task: Describe how your brother spends time in his art club.
student_text: My brother dont use a computer for his art club. He draw cartoons in a notebook instead and shares them with his classmates. We sometimes look at his pictures after dinner and laugh at the funny faces.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My brother doesn't use a computer for his art club. He draws cartoons in a notebook instead and shares them with his classmates. We sometimes look at his pictures after dinner and laugh at the funny faces.

errors.explanation: Use doesn't with the singular subject brother.
Use draws with the singular subject he.

task: Write about a dance class you attended yesterday.
student_text: Yesterday, I go to a dance class with my cousin. The instructor show us a few easy steps, and we practiced in front of a mirror. After class, we waited for a bus and shared a snack.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Yesterday, I went to a dance class with my cousin. The instructor showed us a few easy steps, and we practiced in front of a mirror. After class, we waited for a bus and shared a snack.

errors.explanation: Use went for the completed class yesterday.
Use showed for the completed action yesterday.

task: Describe what you packed for a weekend away.
student_text: I put much shirts and two book into my small bag for the weekend. My friend packed a camera and a warm sweater. We are taking a train to the coast and staying with her aunt.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I put many shirts and two books into my small bag for the weekend. My friend packed a camera and a warm sweater. We are taking a train to the coast and staying with her aunt.

errors.explanation: Use many with the countable plural noun shirts.
Use the plural noun books after two.

task: Write about a birthday lunch you had last weekend.
student_text: Last weekend, we had lunch at my grandmother's home. My uncle bring a large salad, and my aunt made a chocolate cake. We talked in the garden for a while and singed to my cousin after the meal.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: Last weekend, we had lunch at my grandmother's home. My uncle brought a large salad, and my aunt made a chocolate cake. We talked in the garden for a while and sang to my cousin after the meal.

errors.explanation: Use brought for the completed action last weekend.
The past form of sing is sang.

task: Describe what people are doing before a game.
student_text: The team members are wait in the school gym for their captain. One student is filling a bottle, and two friends talking about the score. Their coach is checking a list on the wall before practice.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: The team members are waiting in the school gym for their captain. One student is filling a bottle, and two friends are talking about the score. Their coach is checking a list on the wall before practice.

errors.explanation: Use waiting after are to form the present continuous.
Add are before talking to form the present continuous for the action happening now.

task: Write about a shop you visited on your way home.
student_text: I stopped at a shop after school and bought a apple and a notebook. The cashier gave I change, and I put it in my pocket. My sister waited outside because she wanted to get home before dinner.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: I stopped at a shop after school and bought an apple and a notebook. The cashier gave me change, and I put it in my pocket. My sister waited outside because she wanted to get home before dinner.

errors.explanation: Use an before apple, which begins with a vowel sound.
Use the object pronoun me after gave.

task: Describe a meal you made with a friend.
student_text: My friend and I cooked soup at home last night. I listened music while I cut vegetables, and she boiled rice. Later, our neighbor bring us fresh bread, so we ate together and shared a small dessert.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: My friend and I cooked soup at home last night. I listened to music while I cut vegetables, and she boiled rice. Later, our neighbor brought us fresh bread, so we ate together and shared a small dessert.

errors.explanation: Use listen to before the thing or person you hear.
Use brought for the completed action last night.

task: Write about seeing a teacher during a bus trip.
student_text: When the bus arrived, I climbed in and sat by the window. I seen my old teacher at the next stop and waved to her. We talked until the driver open the doors near the library.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: When the bus arrived, I climbed in and sat by the window. I saw my old teacher at the next stop and waved to her. We talked until the driver opened the doors near the library.

errors.explanation: Use saw, the past form of see, in this past-time account.
Use opened for the completed action during the bus trip.

task: Ask a friend when they leave and describe the journey.
student_text: What time you leave for the airport tomorrow? I can drive you there if you need a ride. The trip dont take long early in the morning, and we can stop for coffee before your flight.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: What time do you leave for the airport tomorrow? I can drive you there if you need a ride. The trip doesn't take long early in the morning, and we can stop for coffee before your flight.

errors.explanation: Use do before the subject in a present simple question.
Use doesn't with the singular subject trip.

task: Describe where you ate lunch and when you will return.
student_text: We had lunch on the kitchen because the table outside was wet. The room is bright, and it looks onto a small garden. I will visit my cousin at Monday and tell her about our meal.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: We had lunch in the kitchen because the table outside was wet. The room is bright, and it looks onto a small garden. I will visit my cousin on Monday and tell her about our meal.

errors.explanation: Use in for a location inside a room.
Use on with a day of the week.

task: Write about two people in a family photograph.
student_text: In this old photograph, her is my grandmother beside the fireplace. She is holding a cat, and my grandfather is sitting next to her. Them are my great-aunts, who came to visit us one summer.
english_variant: British and American standard variants accepted

gold.corrected_text: In this old photograph, she is my grandmother beside the fireplace. She is holding a cat, and my grandfather is sitting next to her. They are my great-aunts, who came to visit us one summer.

errors.explanation: Use the subject pronoun she before is; the longer fragment identifies this occurrence.
Use the subject pronoun they as the subject of are.

task: Tell a friend about information you found for a class project.
